diamond-iq.title: Diamond IQ
diamond-iq.description: Backend + GenAI practice project combining FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and LLMs for natural language baseball queries. Features Tool Calling for structured data, RAG for documentation, LLM Router with Ollama/Gemini/OpenAI fallback, and agentic orchestration with guardrails.
diamond-iq.longDescription: Diamond IQ is a practice project that combines a traditional backend with generative AI capabilities applied to baseball data. It allows asking natural language questions and routes them to the appropriate source: structured player/season data via PostgreSQL tools, or definitions/methodology via RAG over a knowledge base. The system includes an LLM Router supporting Ollama (local), Gemini, and OpenAI with retry/fallback logic, token usage tracking, execution limits, and guardrails for input/output validation. Built as a modular FastAPI application with clean architecture layers (API, AI orchestration, providers, tools, RAG, services, repositories).
diamond-iq.impact: Personal project demonstrating backend + GenAI integration with production-grade patterns: tool calling, RAG, multi-provider routing, observability, and clean architecture.

whatsapp-booking.title: WhatsApp Booking
whatsapp-booking.description: Full-stack SaaS for service businesses to manage bookings via WhatsApp. Customers book, cancel, reschedule; businesses configure services, schedules, and Google Calendar sync from a self-service dashboard. Deployed on Lightsail + Vercel.
whatsapp-booking.longDescription: WhatsApp Booking enables service businesses to manage appointments entirely through WhatsApp. Customers converse naturally to check availability, book, cancel, or reschedule appointments. Businesses self-onboard via Google Admin Sign-In, configure services, schedules, and optionally connect Google Calendar for two-way sync. The system includes a React dashboard for agenda management, WhatsApp Cloud API integration with HMAC verification, Google Calendar OAuth with PKCE, encrypted credential storage, and a reminder engine processed via external scheduler. Built with FastAPI async backend (SQLAlchemy, Alembic, PostgreSQL) and React/TypeScript/Vite frontend. Deployed via Docker Compose on AWS Lightsail with Caddy reverse proxy (HTTPS, rate limiting, fixed IP topology) and Vercel for the frontend.
whatsapp-booking.impact: End-to-end SaaS product: full-stack architecture, third-party integrations (Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, Google Calendar/Identity), production deployment (Lightsail, Vercel, Caddy), security (HMAC, encrypted credentials, HttpOnly sessions), and self-service onboarding flow.
